citations.assessment: The source introduces the objection from Rav Natan, father of Rav Huna, with bar Natan in parentheses after Rav Huna.
The parallel names the father and the son with a longer parenthetical form.
This wording explicitly places Rav Natan, father of Rav Huna son of Rav Natan, before Rav Pappa. The version attests what Heilprin recommends.

holds.reason: The current text supports the stated reading. The precise printed witness represented by the source siglum still requires collation.
